title: Setting up a vending machine that actually sells
target: How to place, stock and price a vending machine in Supermarket Simulator using the machine behaviour the game itself defines.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Enough money to buy the machine
Space in the shop away from the blocked area

steps.do: Pick the spot before you buy, and keep clear of the area where the game will not let a machine stand.
steps.because: the game defines a placement dead zone for machines (VendingMachinePlacementDeadZone)

steps.do: Buy the machine and let it be placed as its own fixture instead of treating it as a shelf.
steps.because: a machine carries its own data and is managed separately from shelving (VendingMachine)

steps.do: Fill the slots with a product you already sell rather than leaving slots empty.
steps.because: the game tracks how many of the machine's slots are filled (collectedSlotCount)

steps.do: Set the machine's own price tags instead of assuming the shelf price carries over.
steps.because: prices hang on the machine's own tags (VendingPriceTag)

steps.do: Leave it to trade and check the machine's own screen on the shop computer later.
steps.because: the machine collects income on its own while you work elsewhere (vendingIncome)

commonMistakes: Buying the machine before checking where it is allowed to stand.
Filling a few slots and forgetting the rest.
Assuming the shelf price is automatically the machine price.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
